title: Implement login rate limiting
goal: Allow at most five failed login attempts per client during a rolling one-minute window. The sixth request from that client during the window must return HTTP 429. Preserve successful authentication behavior and keep the independent tests green.
constraints: Keep the change limited to src/rateLimit.ts and src/app.ts.
Count failed logins only, isolate counters by client, and expire the counter after one minute.
Do not change the supplied tests or verifier scripts.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each client may make five failed login attempts in one minute; the next attempt is rate limited, and another client has an independent counter.
The sixth failed HTTP login request returns 429 after five 401 responses.
Existing valid and invalid authentication behavior remains green.
Automated rate-limit behavior and HTTP 429 tests are present and make their required assertions.
